description: App mentions in a dated sample of AI engine answers; this does not reproduce what ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini show each user. Studio or Enterprise and the ai:read scope are required. `engines` holds each measured engine's answers; `providers` gives measured, failed or not_measured states. An unavailable engine is not a zero score. Read the dated sample and its question count; it is not a universal ranking or a measure of all consumer answers.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)
